rule: Every project has exactly one coordinator
Every project has at least one participation
Control total: EU contribution loaded = EU contribution in the raw files (EUR, rounded)
Unfunded roles (associated partners) carry no EU contribution in the source (kept, excluded from the measure)
Sum of participants' net contributions = project maximum contribution (1 EUR tolerance)
Duplicate organisation candidates (same normalised name and country, different PIC)
Grant signed after the project start date
CORDIS domain codes not found in the official EuroSciVoc (EU Vocabularies)
Domain codes used by CORDIS without any label (path and title empty in the source)
Project total cost not reported (lump sum or unit cost grants)
Organisation leaves and re-joins a project in the same role (two rows, different order)
Reporting periods loaded (not published in CORDIS open data)
Star schema: fact total = model total (EUR, rounded)
Domain bridge weights add up to 1 per classified project
